reason: The first order is cash on delivery and Abu Ali in Shorja vouches for it, so I'd send one small sample order of phone accessories I can't find in the market just to test their quality and timing. For real shop stock though, 13,000 a kilo by air kills my margin; my cargo agents bring it by the bag much cheaper.
objection: Landed cost per piece is too high for resale, and if a whole batch comes wrong or fake, I'm not sure how fast and in full they really refund it after waiting three weeks.
would_change_my_mind: A bulk rate for traders: lower per-kilo shipping on 10+ kilo orders or a sea/land cargo option, so the landed cost per piece beats what I get in Shorja.
